title: NZ Bird of the Year
hook: This week's data is from the New Zealand Forest and Bird Orginization courtesy of Dragonfly Data Science by way of Nathan Moore. Full details around voting can be found at the Bird of the Year site. I have uploaded the raw data and the clean data, was a quick dplyr::pivotlonger() call! Full details around voting are below - please note that votes are ranked 1-5 (1 is best, 5 is worst), and the voters do not need to submit all 5 votes. This year, voting is based on the instant runoff (IRV) voting system, which is similar to the system you might have seen in local elections. When you vote, you can rank up to five of your favourite birds, with #1 indicating your favourite bird, #2 indicating your second favourite bird, and so on. It's no problem if you want to vote for less than five birds.
